reasons: The cited clause (h) contains a clear affiliate/successor/asset-sale carve-out allowing assignment without consent, and any other assignment requires consent not to be unreasonably withheld — this meets the preferred position's material terms and at minimum the fallback (mutual assignment to successors with consent not unreasonably withheld).

No change-of-control termination or re-pricing right in favour of the Vendor is present, consistent with the rule's requirement; the finding correctly notes the only termination triggers are insolvency-type events.

Minor shortfalls (no express bar on Vendor assigning to a Customer competitor; mutual rather than one-way carve-out) are properly noted in the rationale rather than flagged, per the classification guidance on minor sub-elements.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no comment were proposed; the rendered text is unchanged and the deterministic check confirms the carve-out.
